title: Spark UDFs & the Python Boundary
description: Master the cost and correctness implications of crossing the JVM-Python boundary: when Python UDFs collapse performance, when Pandas UDFs save you, and how nullable columns silently break UDF logic that looked fine in tests.
outcomes: You'll predict why a Python UDF is slow, choose Pandas UDFs when vectorisation pays, debug return-type mismatches and null-input failures, and reason about mapPartitions vs map for batch-amortised Python work.
